items.html: It is found that the Malchut within her has no partner opposite it in the male, for she is below his Yesod; therefore it is necessary that the Malchuts within her, being below his entire stature, be raised through him; and then her Malchut, which has no partner, ascends up to her own Yesod, and they are included together there, in the secret of inclusion, as is known to us; and then she is able to receive from the Yesod of ZA. And it is found that in this aspect there is in her a Partzuf of only her upper nine Sefirot, for her tenth is included in her Yesod; and then his Keter is also higher than her Keter.
